description: Logística dos Transportes is a series of datasets listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Fluxos consolidados (ida e volta) entre portos brasileiros e estrangeiros (países/territórios) de "Minério de Ferro" para o ano de 2023. Coverage: Brasil. The portal lists 43 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. Its tags are Logística dos Transportes 2024, Transporte de cargas - Brasil, Fluxos multimodais de carga, Transporte de cargas - Brasil, Transporte de cargas - Internacional. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
